phase3_findings.description: docs/internal/mcp-server/tools.md line 164 (CHAT_INPUT_UPDATE row of the render_interactive table, unchanged by the diff) still ends 'Those are not clarifying questions, so they must never render as the answer', implying other chat-input placeholders are clarifying questions; contradicts the new paragraph at line 158 and the reworded _format.py comment. Criterion 6 sweep site.

Same docs/internal/mcp-server/tools.md line 164 sentence left in the old framing that treats chat-input placeholders as clarifying questions; the matching _format.py comment was reworded but this table row was not.

docs/external/managing-memory.md is unchanged and lacks everything acceptance criterion 5 requires: marking a known ambiguity with a note, a note naming the meaning or a saved pair stopping the question with an example of each, notes reaching the assistant only when background context retrieves them, and the Verifying Memory After an Import guidance (ERROR when no query ran, lookup SQL comparison, state the choice in golden questions).

Acceptance criterion 5 not met: docs/external/managing-memory.md is not edited; no ambiguity-note guidance, no examples, no retrieval caveat, and the Verifying Memory After an Import section (head line 118) has no clarifying-question guidance.
tests/unit/test_server.py new round-trip test docstring says only the model is scripted, but _agent(...) also uses a fake run_sql tool (_FakeRunSql) and a StubAgentMemory.

src/sqllens/tools/_format.py render_interactive docstring's unchanged last sentence says it is used only when a turn produced no TEXT/DATAFRAME answer, but components_to_blocks (lines 555-557) also calls it when blocks serialize to empty Markdown, as the updated tools.md now states.
